meta.note: Structure (semantic bg/text/stroke ladder, status families, type-scale names, control sizes) derived from the Align UI-based finance, HR, marketing and AI templates; values come from the Dibs V3 logo (violet #6D4AFF, lime #C8F03C, ink #141216) and the Friends App product plan.

tokens.name: bg-white-0
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, sheets. In Dark this is a step lighter than the page, so cards still read as raised.

tokens.name: bg-weak-50
tokens.usage: Page background, grouped-list background, chat thread background. The darkest surface in Dark.

tokens.name: bg-soft-200
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, switch and progress tracks, other people's chat bubbles, skeletons.

tokens.name: bg-sub-300
tokens.usage: Pressed neutral fills; heavy dividers.

tokens.name: bg-surface-800
tokens.usage: Tooltips and toasts.

tokens.name: bg-strong-950
tokens.usage: Inverse surface: the ink lockup card, neutral solid buttons.

tokens.name: text-strong-950
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on bg-white-0, bg-weak-50, bg-soft-200.

tokens.name: text-sub-600
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, taglines, helper text on bg-white-0, bg-weak-50, bg-soft-200.

tokens.name: text-soft-400
tokens.usage: Meta, timestamps, placeholders on bg-white-0 and bg-weak-50.

tokens.name: text-disabled-300
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only, deliberately low contrast; never for content.

tokens.name: text-white-0
tokens.usage: Text on bg-strong-950 and bg-surface-800.

tokens.name: stroke-strong-950
tokens.usage: Chunky outlines on sticker cards; selected vote option border.

tokens.name: stroke-sub-300
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and radio borders (3:1 on bg-white-0).

tokens.name: stroke-soft-200
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders.

tokens.name: stroke-white-0
tokens.usage: Ring around stacked avatars.

tokens.name: static-black
tokens.usage: Ink that never flips: text and icons on accent-base (lime) and away-base.

tokens.name: static-white
tokens.usage: White that never flips: text on primary-base, switch thumbs, the friends in the logo.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind bottom sheets and modals.

tokens.name: primary-base
tokens.usage: THE brand colour (the V3 app-icon tile). Primary buttons, active tabs, own chat bubbles, progress. Text on it is static-white.

tokens.name: primary-dark
tokens.usage: Violet text and links on bg-white-0 / bg-weak-50 / primary-lighter.

tokens.name: primary-darker
tokens.usage: Pressed links; violet avatar initials. Not a fill under white text (it turns light in Dark).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of primary buttons. Text on it is static-white in both themes.

tokens.name: primary-bar
tokens.usage: Fill of progress and vote bars. Brand violet in Light; a step brighter in Dark so it stays 3:1 on the bg-soft-200 track.

tokens.name: primary-light
tokens.usage: Selected-row fill, violet badge border.

tokens.name: primary-lighter
tokens.usage: Soft violet fill: lighter badges, selected vote option, highlighted cards.

tokens.name: accent-base
tokens.usage: The “calling dibs” lime. One moment per screen: the winning vote, “I'm in”, squared up. Text on it is static-black, never white.

tokens.name: accent-dark
tokens.usage: Lime-family text on accent-lighter and bg-white-0.

tokens.name: accent-light
tokens.usage: Lime border on soft fills.

tokens.name: accent-lighter
tokens.usage: Soft lime fill behind accent-dark text.

tokens.name: information-base
tokens.usage: Blueberry. Solid fill for status dots, icons and filled badges; text on it is static-black. Neutral info: tips, links in alerts, “what did I miss?” recaps.

tokens.name: information-dark
tokens.usage: Blueberry text and icons on information-lighter and bg-white-0.

tokens.name: information-light
tokens.usage: Blueberry border on soft alerts; stronger soft fill.

tokens.name: information-lighter
tokens.usage: Blueberry soft fill behind information-dark text (alerts, lighter badges).

tokens.name: warning-base
tokens.usage: Apricot. Solid fill for status dots, icons and filled badges; text on it is static-black. Needs attention soon: vote closing, booking cap nearly full.

tokens.name: warning-dark
tokens.usage: Apricot text and icons on warning-lighter and bg-white-0.

tokens.name: warning-light
tokens.usage: Apricot border on soft alerts; stronger soft fill.

tokens.name: warning-lighter
tokens.usage: Apricot soft fill behind warning-dark text (alerts, lighter badges).

tokens.name: error-base
tokens.usage: Cherry. Solid fill for status dots, icons and filled badges; text on it is static-black. Failed payment, can’t make it, invalid input, destructive actions.

tokens.name: error-dark
tokens.usage: Cherry text and icons on error-lighter and bg-white-0.

tokens.name: error-light
tokens.usage: Cherry border on soft alerts; stronger soft fill.

tokens.name: error-lighter
tokens.usage: Cherry soft fill behind error-dark text (alerts, lighter badges).

tokens.name: success-base
tokens.usage: Mint. Solid fill for status dots, icons and filled badges; text on it is static-black. Paid, squared up, plan locked.

tokens.name: success-dark
tokens.usage: Mint text and icons on success-lighter and bg-white-0.

tokens.name: success-light
tokens.usage: Mint border on soft alerts; stronger soft fill.

tokens.name: success-lighter
tokens.usage: Mint soft fill behind success-dark text (alerts, lighter badges).

tokens.name: away-base
tokens.usage: Sunshine. Solid fill for status dots, icons and filled badges; text on it is static-black. Maybe, pending RSVP, waiting on someone.

tokens.name: away-dark
tokens.usage: Sunshine text and icons on away-lighter and bg-white-0.

tokens.name: away-light
tokens.usage: Sunshine border on soft alerts; stronger soft fill.

tokens.name: away-lighter
tokens.usage: Sunshine soft fill behind away-dark text (alerts, lighter badges).

tokens.name: feature-base
tokens.usage: Raspberry. Solid fill for status dots, icons and filled badges; text on it is static-black. New features and upgrades.

tokens.name: feature-dark
tokens.usage: Raspberry text and icons on feature-lighter and bg-white-0.

tokens.name: feature-light
tokens.usage: Raspberry border on soft alerts; stronger soft fill.

tokens.name: feature-lighter
tokens.usage: Raspberry soft fill behind feature-dark text (alerts, lighter badges).

tokens.name: verified-base
tokens.usage: Lagoon. Solid fill for status dots, icons and filled badges; text on it is static-black. Verified PayID, booked with a partner.

tokens.name: verified-dark
tokens.usage: Lagoon text and icons on verified-lighter and bg-white-0.

tokens.name: verified-light
tokens.usage: Lagoon border on soft alerts; stronger soft fill.

tokens.name: verified-lighter
tokens.usage: Lagoon soft fill behind verified-dark text (alerts, lighter badges).

tokens.name: highlighted-base
tokens.usage: Tangerine. Solid fill for status dots, icons and filled badges; text on it is static-black. Celebrations: card-roulette results, someone shouted.

tokens.name: highlighted-dark
tokens.usage: Tangerine text and icons on highlighted-lighter and bg-white-0.

tokens.name: highlighted-light
tokens.usage: Tangerine border on soft alerts; stronger soft fill.

tokens.name: highlighted-lighter
tokens.usage: Tangerine soft fill behind highlighted-dark text (alerts, lighter badges).

tokens.name: stable-base
tokens.usage: Seafoam. Solid fill for status dots, icons and filled badges; text on it is static-black. Steady state: recurring plan, online, active.

tokens.name: stable-dark
tokens.usage: Seafoam text and icons on stable-lighter and bg-white-0.

tokens.name: stable-light
tokens.usage: Seafoam border on soft alerts; stronger soft fill.

tokens.name: stable-lighter
tokens.usage: Seafoam soft fill behind stable-dark text (alerts, lighter badges).

tokens.name: faded-base
tokens.usage: Pebble. Solid fill for status dots, icons and filled badges; text on it is static-black. Archived, draft, past plans.

tokens.name: faded-dark
tokens.usage: Pebble text and icons on faded-lighter and bg-white-0.

tokens.name: faded-light
tokens.usage: Pebble border on soft alerts; stronger soft fill.

tokens.name: faded-lighter

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus outline with a 2px offset on every interactive element (≥3:1 on all surfaces).

styles.name: title-display
styles.usage: Marketing heroes on screens ≥ 768px. On phones use title-h2.

styles.name: title-h1
styles.usage: Page hero on tablet/desktop. On phones step down to title-h3. Always sentence case or lowercase, never Title Case.

styles.name: title-h2
styles.usage: Section heroes; the largest title on phones.

styles.name: title-h5
styles.usage: Section headers inside cards, modal titles on phones.

styles.name: label-md
styles.usage: Default buttons, form labels, list row titles. The workhorse.

styles.name: paragraph-lg
styles.sample: Share a link in the group chat. Nobody has to install anything to vote.

styles.name: paragraph-md
styles.sample: Dinner’s sorted. You owe Sam $42, tap to pay.
styles.usage: Default body copy. Never set reading text smaller than this on phones.

styles.name: paragraph-sm
styles.usage: Hints, helper text, secondary row text.

styles.name: subheading-sm
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above a group of rows. Write it in capitals.

styles.name: number-md
styles.usage: Amounts in rows and tables; aligns digits.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields' label and control; list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter; card padding on phones; default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on tablet and up.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, kbd keys.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, small buttons, tooltips; the 40px app icon.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, default buttons, segmented controls, vote options; the 64px app icon.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, plan cards, alerts, chat bubbles, the ink lockup card.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and modals (top corners on phones).

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App-icon tile at any size (48 on 200, from the V3 logo).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, badges, avatars, switches.

size.note: Control heights. Everything tappable is at least size-tap.

tokens.name: size-tap
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for anything tappable (WCAG 2.5.5 / Apple HIG).

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons: the one main action at the bottom of a phone screen.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons inside cards on desktop; pad the hit area to size-tap on touch.

motion.note: Animate only to show cause and effect or to reward a moment. Nothing loops in the background. Under prefers-reduced-motion, 3D moments become a still and a fade.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, toggles.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Most transitions: cards appearing, values changing, tabs.

tokens.name: motion-expressive
tokens.usage: Signature pops and reveals.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default easing.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Pop-ups: a figure springing up, like calling dibs. Overshoots a touch.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving: delete, cancel, dismiss.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Inputs and resting buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards that float over the cream page.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdowns, tooltips, sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Sticker shadow for the one lime or violet hero action on a screen and sticker cards with a stroke-strong-950 border. Collapses to 0 on press.
